How to play Two Truths Speed Round

Two truths, one lie — but fast Like Two Truths and a Lie but with a 10-second time limit per statement. No time to craft perfect lies. The panic makes it funnier and harder to read.

2–10 players~12 minQuick & RevealingMemory & chain games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. One player says three rapid-fire statements about themselves.
  2. Each statement gets maximum 10 seconds — no overthinking.
  3. Two are true. One is a lie.
  4. Others vote simultaneously on which is the lie.
  5. Most correct votes wins. Rotate to the next player.

Example round

  • 'I've been to Japan' / 'I can play guitar' / 'I've never eaten sushi'
  • The lie was 'I can play guitar' — but the Japan one seemed more suspicious.
  • Speed pressure makes people accidentally tell the truth when they meant to lie.

Tips

  • Make the lie mundane and the truths wild — it's a better trick.
  • React the same way to all three statements to throw off the group.
